defect: Discovery cleanup depended on a control-owned timer; closing the panel could cancel timeout handling. Immediate terminate/join(0) also discarded a child before its exit was confirmed.
repair: An application-owned Qt timer continues discovery timeout and nonblocking reaping after panel destruction. The process remains owned until confirmed exited and closed; termination escalates to kill after one second. Application exit performs bounded terminate/kill cleanup. Existing captions and saved control values are unchanged.

validation.gpu_visibility: CUDA, HIP and ROCr devices hidden
essential_cases: Panel destruction does not cancel discovery timeout and cleanup.
Delayed termination retains ownership, escalates once, and closes only after exit.
The application exit signal terminates, escalates and reaps pending discovery.
A real spawned CPU-only child completes and is reaped while Torch remains absent in the GUI process.

limitations: No physical-GPU or frozen-platform acceptance claimed.
Shutdown waits at most 0.2 seconds after terminate and 0.2 seconds after kill; a process still alive remains retained for interpreter shutdown.
